title: Packing a PCPP description
statement: Let a semantic reduction assign to every Boolean circuit with positive input length a PCPP description for the property accepted by that circuit, and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with positive input length. The packed PCPP description built from $C$ has source circuit $C$ and description equal to the one assigned to $C$ by the reduction.
hypotheses_covered: A semantic reduction assigning a PCPP description to each Boolean circuit with positive input length
